title: Amiss semantic evidence
description: One trusted producer's bounded observations over an exact candidate. The envelope authenticates no source by itself: authority belongs to the external lane that supplies it, and only compiled consumers assign semantics to observation kinds.

payload_digest.description: The domain-separated digest of the canonical payload under its schema identity.

complete.description: Whether the producer completed the exact input its input digest names. A consumer may use absence only when its own kind contract requires a complete set and this value is true.

observations.description: Canonical-JSON-sorted unique facts. Each compiled consumer owns the closed grammar and judgment of the kinds it recognizes; unknown kinds remain inert data.

candidate_identity_digest.description: The scanner candidate-identity digest, which already binds repository identity, refs, base and candidate materialization, and forge semantics.

source_report_payload_digest.description: The verified report payload this evidence derives from, or null when a producer ran before report construction.

kind.description: The bounded producer class selected by a compiled consumer.

identity.description: The stable producer implementation identity within that class.

input_digest.description: The producer-kind-defined digest of every configuration, inventory, or completed build input needed to interpret completeness and observations.
